name: kos-monorepo
description: Root-level test runner for the code-level regression suite under tests/ — kos-personal, cas-ccps, and leader-hub each stay independently versioned Apps Script / static-HTML systems, not npm packages; this file exists only to give the repo a single `npm test` entry point, matching the convention tools/gas-lint and tools/clasp-sync already use (plain CommonJS, no build step, no framework dependency beyond Node's own built-in test runner).
